deciders.engine: The engine gives the result with no AI and no person.
deciders.ai: The engine raises a question with evidence, and the AI answers it. A person confirms the sample.
deciders.person: Since 2026-10-14 no fault has this decider: the AI answers every question with the facts of the engine, and the verifier checks it. A person can still answer.

base_expected.note: The result of each criterion on the base site, with no fault, as the engine gives it. Criteria not listed give 'no issue found'.
base_expected.1.4.3_note: axe-core cannot decide the contrast of the text in the open directions dialog, because the dialog overlaps the page. The engine measures the pixels and finds no issue.
base_expected.2.4.4_note: The articles page has a card with a Read more link. Its heading gives the context, so the AI must answer no issue. The question is a truth of no issue for the verifier.
base_expected.3.3.7_note: The order process tests the redundant entry. The review step fills the email, so there is no candidate.

faults.title: The market image has no alt attribute

edits.find: width="640" height="240" alt="A row of three market stalls with striped awnings. The stalls hold fruit, bread, and fish."

faults.solution: Give the image an alt attribute that describes the stalls.

faults.title: The market image is marked decorative with an empty alt, but it carries information

edits.find: alt="A row of three market stalls with striped awnings. The stalls hold fruit, bread, and fish."

faults.solution: Replace the empty alt with a description, because the caption refers to the picture.

faults.title: The alt text of the market image is the file name

edits.find: alt="A row of three market stalls with striped awnings. The stalls hold fruit, bread, and fish."

faults.solution: Replace the file name with a description of the stalls.

faults.title: The share button of the mackerel has an icon only and no accessible name
faults.solution: Add aria-label="Share Mackerel" to the button, or visible text.

faults.title: The produce table has no header cells
faults.solution: Mark the first row and the first column as header cells with th and scope.

faults.title: The name field of the contact form has a label that is not associated with it
faults.solution: Give the label a for attribute with the id of the field.

faults.title: The steps show in the reverse of their code order
faults.solution: Remove the column-reverse style, or put the steps in the code in the order that they show.

faults.title: The instruction for the tabs refers to shape, color, and position only

edits.find: Select the Summer tab to see the articles of the summer.
edits.replace: Click the round green button on the right to see the articles of the summer.

faults.solution: Name the control in the instruction: Select the Summer tab.

faults.title: A style rotates the page in portrait, so that it is readable in landscape only

edits.append: @media (orientation: portrait) { body { transform: rotate(90deg); transform-origin: left top; width: 100vh; } }

faults.solution: Remove the rotation on the orientation media feature.

faults.title: The email field has an autocomplete value with a typing error
faults.solution: Correct the value to autocomplete="email".

faults.title: The name field collects the name of the user with no autocomplete attribute
faults.solution: Add autocomplete="name" to the field.

faults.title: The links in the text have no underline, and their color differs from the text by less than 3:1
faults.solution: Keep the underline on links in text, or give the link color a contrast of 3:1 with the text and a second cue on hover and focus.

faults.title: The recording plays automatically for five seconds and has no controls

edits.find: <audio controls src="media/tone.wav">Your browser does not play audio.</audio>
edits.replace: <audio autoplay src="media/tone.wav">Your browser does not play audio.</audio>

faults.solution: Remove autoplay, or add controls that can pause or stop the audio.

faults.title: The body text is light gray on white, with a contrast of 3.3:1
faults.solution: Use a text color with a contrast of at least 4.5:1 on white, for example #1f2933.

faults.title: The placeholder of the email field is light gray, with a contrast of 1.9:1
faults.solution: Give the placeholder a color with a contrast of at least 4.5:1, for example #52606d.

faults.title: The viewport meta tag blocks the zoom
faults.solution: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable from the viewport meta tag.

faults.title: The header has a fixed height and hides its links when they wrap at 200% zoom or at a small width

edits.append:
header.site { height: 56px; overflow: hidden; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
@media (max-width: 480px) { header.site { flex-direction: row; } }

faults.solution: Remove the fixed height and let the header wrap.

faults.title: The delivery banner is an image of text

edits.find: Free delivery on orders above 40 euros.

faults.solution: Replace the image with styled text.

faults.title: The product cards have a minimum width of 720 px and need a horizontal scroll at 320 px
faults.solution: Remove the minimum width, so that the cards stack at small widths.

faults.title: The borders of the fields and buttons are light gray, with a contrast of 1.5:1
faults.solution: Use a border color with a contrast of at least 3:1 on white, for example #6b7280.

faults.title: The focus ring is a pale pink with a contrast of 1.2:1 on white
faults.solution: Use a focus color with a contrast of at least 3:1 with the background, for example #b3261e.

faults.title: A paragraph fixes its letter spacing and line height with !important in a style attribute

edits.find: The table shows the produce of the spring months.
edits.replace: The table shows the produce of the spring months.

faults.solution: Remove the !important spacing from the style attribute.

faults.title: The cards have a fixed height and cut their text when the user applies the text spacing
faults.solution: Remove the fixed height of the cards.

faults.title: The Brix tooltip does not close with Esc and closes when the pointer moves onto it
faults.solution: Close the tooltip with Esc, and keep it open while the pointer is on it.

faults.title: The Apply control is a div with a click handler, and the keyboard cannot reach it

edits.append: .button-like { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); cursor: pointer; }

faults.solution: Use a button element for the Apply control.

faults.title: The Summer tab has tabindex -1 and the arrow keys do nothing, so the keyboard cannot reach it

edits.find:
if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { select(tabs[(i + 1) % tabs.length]); }
        if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { select(tabs[(i - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length]); }

faults.solution: Move between the tabs with the arrow keys, or give each tab tabindex 0.

faults.title: A question field stops the Tab key, so the focus cannot leave it
faults.solution: Remove the keydown handler that stops the Tab key.

faults.title: The letter S moves the focus to the search field, with no modifier and no setting to switch it off

edits.replace:
<script src="app.js"></script>
<script>document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "s" && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey && e.target.tagName !== "INPUT" && e.target.tagName !== "TEXTAREA") { e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById("q").focus(); } });</script>

faults.solution: Require a modifier key for the shortcut, or give a setting to switch it off.

faults.title: The home page reloads itself every 30 seconds with a meta refresh
faults.solution: Remove the meta refresh.

faults.title: The sign-in page goes to the home page after 20 seconds, with no warning and no way to extend the time
faults.solution: Remove the timer, or warn the user and let them extend the time.

faults.title: The delivery banner changes its text every 3 seconds and has no pause control

edits.find: Free delivery on orders above 40 euros.
edits.replace: Free delivery on orders above 40 euros.

faults.solution: Add a pause control next to the banner, or stop the automatic change.

faults.title: The delivery banner scrolls across the page without an end and has no pause control

edits.append:
@keyframes slide { from { transform: translateX(100%); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
#promo { animation: slide 8s linear infinite; }

faults.solution: Remove the animation, or add a pause control.

faults.title: The delivery banner flashes red and white five times each second over a large area

edits.append:
@keyframes flash { 0%, 49% { background: #ff0000; } 50%, 100% { background: #ffffff; } }
#promo { animation: flash 0.2s step-end infinite; padding: 40px; }

faults.solution: Remove the flash animation.

faults.title: The home page has no skip link and no landmarks
faults.solution: Restore the skip link, and use header, nav, and main elements.

faults.title: The home page has no title
faults.solution: Add a title element: Home: Harbor Market.

faults.title: The articles page and the products page have the same title, which does not describe them
faults.solution: Give each page a title with its topic first: Articles: Harbor Market.

faults.title: The footer links have positive tabindex values and get the focus before the content

edits.replace:
• Sitemap
  • Contact us
  • Privacy

faults.solution: Remove the tabindex attributes.

faults.title: Two links say Read more and go to different pages, with no context in the list items

edits.find: • Read how to store bread for a week
• Read the guide to seasonal produce

faults.solution: Say where each link goes: Read how to store bread for a week.

faults.title: The transcript link has an icon only and no accessible name

edits.find: Read the transcript of the recording

faults.solution: Give the link text, or an aria-label that says Read the transcript of the recording.

faults.title: No link points to the bread storage article, and it is only in the XML sitemap

edits.find: • Read how to store bread for a week
• How to store bread for a week

edits.replace: Read the article on the storage page.

faults.solution: Link to the article from the articles page and from the sitemap page.

faults.title: The headings of the storage article say Section 1 and Section 2
faults.solution: Use headings that describe the content: Day 1 to 3, Day 4 to 7.

faults.title: The focus outline is removed on all controls
faults.solution: Restore the outline on :focus-visible.

faults.title: A sticky header of 140 px hides the control that has the focus when the focus moves backwards

edits.append: header.site { position: sticky; top: 0; background: #fff; z-index: 5; min-height: 140px; }

faults.solution: Add scroll-padding-top equal to the header height, or make the header static.

faults.title: A fixed cookie banner with no close control hides the footer links when they get the focus

edits.replace: We use cookies for the cart. Read the privacy page.

faults.solution: Add scroll-padding-bottom equal to the banner height, or let the user close the banner.

faults.title: The delivery area map needs a pinch to zoom and two fingers to pan, with no buttons

edits.replace:
Delivery area

Your delivery order

faults.solution: Add zoom and pan buttons that work with one pointer.

faults.title: The Add to cart buttons act when the pointer goes down
faults.solution: Act on the click event, which completes on the up event.

faults.title: The Apply button shows Apply but its accessible name is Sort the products
faults.solution: Remove the aria-label, or start it with the visible text: Apply the sort.

faults.title: A shake of the device empties the cart, and no control does the same

edits.replace:
<script src="app.js"></script>
<script>window.addEventListener("devicemotion", function (e) { if (e.acceleration && Math.abs(e.acceleration.x) > 15) { document.getElementById("status").textContent = "The cart is empty."; } });</script>

faults.solution: Add a button that empties the cart, and let the user switch the shake off.

faults.title: The delivery order can only be changed with a drag

edits.find: Drag an item, or use the buttons, to change the order of the delivery.
edits.replace: Drag an item to change the order of the delivery.

edits.find: • Apples from Oak Farm
• Sourdough bread
• Mackerel

faults.solution: Add Move up and Move down buttons to each item.

faults.title: The favorite and share buttons are 18 by 18 px with no space between them

edits.find: .icon-button { width: 44px; height: 44px; min-height: 0; padding: 0; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; }
edits.replace: .icon-button { width: 18px; height: 18px; min-height: 0; padding: 0; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; }

faults.solution: Make the buttons at least 24 by 24 px, or give them 24 px of space.

faults.title: The home page has no lang attribute
faults.solution: Add lang="en" to the html element.

faults.title: The home page is in English but declares French
faults.solution: Change the lang attribute to en.

faults.title: The French quote has no lang attribute
faults.solution: Add lang="fr" to the blockquote.

faults.title: The address field opens the help page when it gets the focus
faults.solution: Remove the onfocus handler.

faults.title: A change of the Sort by select loads a new page with no warning
faults.solution: Remove the onchange handler and keep the Apply button, or tell the user before the select that a change loads the page.

faults.title: The main navigation of the help page has a different order
faults.solution: Use the same order of the navigation links on all pages.

faults.title: The search button is named Go on the help page and Search on the other pages
faults.solution: Name the button Search on all pages.

faults.title: The Help and Contact links are in the footer on the sign-in page and in the header on the other pages

edits.find: Harbor Market is a test site of the Accessibility Audit project. Nothing is for sale.
edits.replace:
Help Contact

Harbor Market is a test site of the Accessibility Audit project. Nothing is for sale.

faults.solution: Keep the Help and Contact links in the header, in the same order as on the other pages.

faults.title: The contact form shows an error only with a red border, with no text
faults.solution: Show the error in text next to the field and in the error summary.

faults.title: The contact form fields have placeholders and no visible labels

edits.find:
<label for="contact-name">Your name</label>
      <input type="text" id="contact-name" name="name" autocomplete="name" required>
edits.replace: <input type="text" id="contact-name" name="name" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Your name" required>

edits.find: For our answer, for example name@example.com.
edits.replace: <input type="email" id="contact-email" name="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="Your email" required>

faults.solution: Add a visible label to each field. A placeholder disappears when the user types.

faults.title: The error for the delivery date says Invalid input, and no text near the field gives the format

edits.find: message = "Enter " + name.toLowerCase() + " as a date in the format 2026-10-13.";

faults.solution: Say how to correct the error: Enter the delivery date in the format 2026-10-13.

faults.title: The order form with the card number sends the order with no review step
faults.solution: Add a review step before the confirmation, or let the user cancel the order after the confirmation.

faults.title: The review step asks for the email again, which the user gave in step 1

edits.find:
var email = document.getElementById("confirm-email");
    if (email) { email.value = saved.email || ""; }

faults.solution: Fill the email field with the value from step 1.

faults.title: The password field blocks the paste and the autofill, and the sign-in link alternative is removed

edits.replace: <input type="password" id="password" name="password" autocomplete="off" onpaste="return false" required>

edits.find: No password? Get a sign-in link by email.

faults.solution: Permit the paste and the autofill in the password field.

faults.title: The sign-in has a CAPTCHA with letters in an image, and no other method

edits.find: No password? Get a sign-in link by email.

faults.solution: Remove the CAPTCHA from the sign-in, or give a method with no cognitive function test.

faults.title: The Fish filter is a div with a click handler, with no role, no name, and no state
faults.solution: Use a checkbox input with a label.

faults.title: The disclosure buttons open their panel but keep aria-expanded false
faults.solution: Set aria-expanded to true when the panel opens, and to false when it closes.

faults.title: The cart message appears in a plain div, with no live region and no focus change
faults.solution: Give the message container role="status".

faults.title: The recording has no transcript link

edits.find: Read the transcript of the recording

faults.solution: Add a link to a transcript of the recording next to the player.

faults.title: The steps look like a numbered list but are a paragraph with line breaks

edits.find:
1. Choose your products on the products page.
  2. Give your details on the order page.
  3. Review your order and confirm it.
edits.replace:
1. Choose your products on the products page.
2. Give your details on the order page.
3. Review your order and confirm it.

faults.solution: Use an ol element with one li for each step.

faults.title: The directions dialog keeps the focus: Esc does not close it, and it has no Close button

edits.replace:
openMap.addEventListener("click", function () { mapDialog.showModal(); });
    mapDialog.addEventListener("cancel", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });

faults.state: click Show the directions to the pier
faults.solution: Let Esc close the dialog, and add a Close button inside it.

faults.title: The link in the opening hours panel shows no focus indicator
faults.solution: Remove the rule that hides the outline of the link in the panel.

faults.title: The image in the Summer tab panel has no alt attribute

edits.find: alt="The fish stall at the end of the pier, with the morning catch on ice.">

faults.solution: Add an alt attribute that says what the image shows.

faults.title: The text over the image lost its dark band, so white text sits on the light image
faults.solution: Give the text a solid or dark band behind it, or a text color with 4.5:1 against all parts of the image.
